title: OpenAI and Cisco launch Shirudo, an open-source runtime that helps teams protect running Linux systems without a reboot while they roll out patches (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Mike Wheatley / SiliconANGLE: OpenAI and Cisco launch Shirudo, an open-source runtime that helps teams protect running Linux systems without a reboot while they roll out patches — Cybercriminals have gained the ability to discover vulnerabilities in software and take advantage of them in seconds, and it's all thanks to artificial intelligence.
